c. 1949
The following is a faithful transcription of typed notes by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
A MILLION-DOLLAR PROPOSITION: (NO. I)
HOPE, THE SOUL OF TERRESTIAL HAPPINESS: DESPAIR? ? LORD SAVE US! A FORETASTE OF HELL. "KNOW THE TRUTH AND THE TRUTH WILL MAKE YOU FREE." -
For the best popular definition and contrasting of two Extremes of most fundamental importance - RELIGION, the "UNRECOGNIZED SCIENCE": AND ATHEISM, THE CLIMAX OF INTELLECTUAL INSANITY AND OF MORAL DEPRAV- ITY: we shall offer a million-dollar prize; - said definitions, etc, not to exceed fifteen hundred words and to avoid undue refrence to any particular system, or denomination. Who "we" are to make such an of- fer will follow shortly. For the present let it suffice to say that though the writer can hardly claim a red copper as his own; he is nevertheless confident that this proposition is so timely, so urgent just now and so opportune; that, though he know there are indivi- duals , both Christian and Jewish - possibly Pagans too - who would be happy to donate the whole million at once; he would prefer not to ac- cept such an offer. He feels rather that a convention of some kind should be called without delay: - say of reverend clergy and God-fear- ing lay editors under perhaps a chosen commitee of bishops, and rabbis who are known for their faith in God and earnestness to promote human peace on earth and save immortal souls.
Incidently, it was only about eight or ten years back that a Rev- erend Rabbi R. - God bless him - came to consult a Christian clergiman; lamenting the threatening groth of atheism among the rising generation, notably among the Jewish denomination. Without one word the latter wrote on a piece of tissue-paper just at hand: "If there's anything of good to come from atheism - in itself the climax of insanity - it is this; It is going to force all those together and ... to harmony, who honestly and gratefully belive in almighty God." At this Rabbi R. who had been steadying the corner of said tisue exclaimed as he struck the desk: "That's inspiration!" Atheism has been becoming more and more threatening ever since till now - especially since the appalling scan- dal of our honorable Supreme Court last year; for since that unfortu- nate quasie approval, it has advanced by leaps and bounds, till red Russian atheism seems just waiting for a chance to take over in place of religion, that of course would mean of every system of religion in America as well as in the Soviet countries, for the final aim of athe- ism has ever been --- every thought of belief and faith in God and the supernatural.
(Unfinished draft)
